mapper.sql: select p.id, p.prompt_type, p.system_prompt, p.temperature, p.max_tokens, p.is_active, GROUP_CONCAT(t.type_name SEPARATOR '，') as type_names, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from news_prompt_config p left join news_prompt_type_relation r on p.id = r.prompt_config_id left join news_type_config t on r.type_config_id = t.id
mapper.select: select p.id, p.prompt_type, p.system_prompt, p.temperature, p.max_tokens, p.is_active, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from news_prompt_config p inner join news_prompt_type_relation r on p.id = r.prompt_config_id where r.type_config_id = #{typeConfigId} and p.prompt_type = #{promptType} and p.is_active = 1 limit 1
select type_config_id from news_prompt_type_relation where prompt_config_id = #{promptConfigId}
mapper.insert: insert into news_prompt_config ( prompt_type, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, is_active, remark, create_by,create_time )values( #{promptType}, #{systemPrompt}, #{temperature}, #{maxTokens}, #{isActive}, #{remark}, #{createBy},sysdate() )
mapper.update: update news_prompt_config prompt_type=#{promptType}, system_prompt=#{systemPrompt}, temperature=#{temperature}, max_tokens=#{maxTokens}, is_active=#{isActive}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id}
mapper.delete: delete from news_prompt_config where id in #{id}
